'''Cradjius Lucern''' was the owner of [[Marqo's]], which he turned into a [[Casino/Legends|casino]] and [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]]. He took over from the former owner when his predecessor fled the [[Demophon system/Legends|Demophon system's]] imminent [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]]. Lucern preyed on panicking citizens who gambled in the hopes of winning enough [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to flee the planet. Lucern had some connections with the [[G'uotr Network]], but at heart he was a loner. His connections were just enough to guarantee him passage with the Network off [[Demophon]] before the supernova. In return, he skimmed a portion of his profits for the Network, and allowed them to use Marqo's as a meeting place for their agents.<ref name="TC" />
